mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the sensory and motor roots was most worthwhile: the picture showed how messages can travel in opposite directions along separate fibres in one nerve.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the brain in the skull was clear but predictable, so it felt less engaging than seeing how the nerve works.

surprise.text: I was surprised that local spinal cord circuits can produce rapid responses without waiting for a conscious decision.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the goals and pictures explained the connections, though the last two combinations were the only offered actions.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter to see how these nerve routes connect to the body's responses. The separate message paths made me curious.
